reasons.grid_loss_pending: Grid voltage out of range — confirmation pending
reasons.grid_voltage_unavailable: Grid voltage entity unavailable — previous state retained

notifications.name: Target name
notifications.hours_help: One daily window, without crossing midnight. Start included, end excluded. Default: 07:00–22:00.
notifications.delivery_help: No recipients selected = no delivery. Save to apply changes. Persistent alerts still present when the window opens are delivered; one-time events outside the window are not replayed.
notifications.no_targets: No targets. Use Manage to add a device.
notifications.test_help: The test bypasses target activation and quiet hours. It checks delivery without simulating a battery condition.
notifications.invalid_target: Choose an available destination and a name. Window start must precede its end.
notifications.duplicate_target: This destination has already been added.
notifications.confirm_delete: Delete this target and its notification associations?

soc_low.title: SOC below…
soc_low.description: Notify when a selected battery drops below its SOC threshold.

soc_high.title: SOC above…
soc_high.description: Notify when SOC exceeds the battery threshold.

full.title: Battery full
full.description: Report when SOC reaches the battery charge completion threshold.

soc_recovered.title: SOC recovered
soc_recovered.description: Report recovery above the resume threshold after a low SOC was observed.

soc_gap.title: SOC difference
soc_gap.description: Compare each selected battery’s SOC with the other selected batteries, using its own threshold. At least two available SOC measurements are required.

temperature_high.title: High temperature
temperature_high.description: Report temperature above the threshold; requires a temperature entity.

temperature_low.title: Low temperature
temperature_low.description: Report temperature below the configured threshold.

temperature_recovered.title: Temperature recovered
temperature_recovered.description: Use the high and low temperature alert thresholds to detect recovery.

charge_start.title: Charging started
charge_start.description: Report a transition to charging based on measured power.

charge_end.title: Charging ended
charge_end.description: Report charging ending after an observed charging phase.

discharge_start.title: Discharging started
discharge_start.description: Report a transition to discharging based on measured power.

discharge_end.title: Discharging ended
discharge_end.description: Report discharging ending after an observed discharging phase.

standby.title: Standby
standby.description: Report measured power within the configured positive and negative thresholds.

mode_unexpected.title: Unexpected mode
mode_unexpected.description: Compare Marstek Force Mode with the requested mode. Requires a Force Mode entity; does not infer a firmware cause.

underpower.title: Power below setpoint
underpower.description: Report power below the selected percentage of the setpoint for the confirmation duration. BMS or hardware limits may explain an offset.

charge_overpower.title: Charging power exceeded
charge_overpower.description: Report measured charging power above the threshold.

discharge_overpower.title: Discharging power exceeded
discharge_overpower.description: Report measured discharging power above the threshold.

standby_power.title: Power during requested standby
standby_power.description: Report power above the threshold while Battery Manager requests standby.

command_error.title: Command send failed
command_error.description: Report an error returned while Battery Manager sends a command.

command_unconfirmed.title: Setpoint not followed
command_unconfirmed.description: Compare measured and requested power using a watt tolerance and duration. A successful send does not prove that the battery applied it.

command_recovered.title: Commands recovered
command_recovered.description: Report an observed command send error clearing.

program_start.title: Program started
program_start.description: Report a different schedule block or profile starting. Identical blocks do not generate duplicates.

program_end.title: Program ended
program_end.description: Report a program being replaced by the next one.

program_blocked.title: Program blocked
program_blocked.description: Report SOC protection or unavailable data/command preventing application. Temperature protection is reported only if supported by the controller.

automatic_mode.title: Automatic mode change
automatic_mode.description: Report a mode change requested by the scheduler; separate from manual quick modes.

weather_change.title: Weather profile changed
weather_change.description: Report a profile change determined by weather analysis.

weather_unavailable.title: Weather data unavailable
weather_unavailable.description: Report unavailable forecasts from the configured source.

weather_recovered.title: Weather data recovered
weather_recovered.description: Report forecasts recovering after an observed outage.

battery_unavailable.title: Battery unavailable
battery_unavailable.description: Report both SOC and power being unavailable.

battery_recovered.title: Battery recovered
battery_recovered.description: Report measurements returning after an observed outage.

sensor_unavailable.title: Measurement unavailable
sensor_unavailable.description: Monitor SOC, power and temperature entities configured for the battery. Unconfigured entities are ignored.

sensor_stale.title: Stale measurement
sensor_stale.description: Use the last Home Assistant report, including unchanged values; a stable SOC is not a failure.

grid_unavailable.title: Grid measurement unavailable
grid_unavailable.description: Monitor the grid power entity configured in Battery Manager.

grid_recovered.title: Grid measurement recovered
grid_recovered.description: Report the grid measurement returning after an observed outage.

connection_lost.title: MQTT connection lost
connection_lost.description: For MQTT batteries: monitor Home Assistant’s broker connection. For Modbus use measurement alerts; transport state is not exposed by the current configuration.

connection_recovered.title: MQTT connection recovered
connection_recovered.description: Report Home Assistant’s MQTT broker connection recovering.

daily_summary.title: Daily summary
daily_summary.description: Summary of selected batteries: SOC, daily energy when available and current anomalies. One delivery per day and target.

journal.retention: Retention: 30 days · 50 MB maximum across all journals
journal.confirm_clear: Clear every journal in all five tabs? This cannot be undone.
